spec.description: Everything at a glance: what came in, what went out, what you own, and where it happened. Transfers between your own accounts are excluded from every spending and income figure.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum(outflow) AS "Spending"
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

spec.description: Money that left your finances in the selected range. Transfers between your own accounts are excluded.
spec.title: Spending

spec.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(merchant, '(no merchant yet)') AS merchant,
       sum(outflow) AS spend
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

spec.description: One bar per business, however many ways your bank spells it.
spec.title: Top Merchants

spec.rawSql:
SELECT "time", net_worth AS "Net worth"
FROM v_net_worth_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Not filtered by account: net worth only means something across all of them.
spec.title: Net Worth Over Time

spec.rawSql:
SELECT account, balance
FROM v_account_latest_balance
ORDER BY balance DESC

spec.description: Current computed balance per account. Credit cards sit below zero while you owe on them.
spec.title: Account Balances

spec.rawSql:
SELECT g.latitude,
       g.longitude,
       coalesce(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY g.merchant),
                max(g.place), 'Unknown') AS place,
       max(g.city)       AS city,
       sum(g.outflow)    AS spend,
       count(*)          AS visits,
       max(g.popularity) AS popularity
FROM v_spending_geo g
WHERE $__timeFilter(g."time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR g.account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY g.location_id, g.latitude, g.longitude
ORDER BY spend DESC

spec.description: One marker per place, sized and shaded by total spending. Repeat visits to one storefront are a single marker. Only transactions carrying coordinates appear - see the mapped share beside this panel.
spec.title: Finances Geographically

spec.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * coalesce(sum(outflow) FILTER (WHERE location_id IS NOT NULL), 0)
             / nullif(sum(outflow), 0), 1) AS "Mapped %"
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

spec.description: How much of the spending in range carries coordinates, and so appears on the map. Read the map against this number.
spec.title: Mapped %

spec.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY g.merchant),
                max(g.place), 'Unknown') AS "Place",
       max(g.city)              AS "City",
       count(*)                 AS "Visits",
       sum(g.outflow)           AS "Total",
       round(avg(g.outflow), 2) AS "Average"
FROM v_spending_geo g
WHERE $__timeFilter(g."time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR g.account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY g.location_id
ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 25

spec.description: The map's data, for reading rather than looking.
spec.title: Top Places

spec.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(posted_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
       account      AS "Account",
       coalesce(merchant, description) AS "Merchant",
       coalesce(category_path, 'Uncategorized') AS "Category",
       outflow      AS "Amount"
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
ORDER BY outflow DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT direction     AS "Direction",
       transactions  AS "Rows",
       gross_amount  AS "Gross",
       unpaired_legs AS "Unpaired"
FROM v_direction_summary
ORDER BY transactions DESC

spec.description: What the source files say about each movement. Unpaired legs are internal rows whose counterpart is missing, usually an account that has not been imported.
spec.title: Directions

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum(inflow) AS "Income"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

spec.description: Money arriving from outside, internal movement excluded.
spec.title: Income

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum(inflow) - sum(outflow) AS "Net"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

spec.description: Income minus spending. Red below zero.
spec.title: Net

spec.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (sum(inflow) - sum(outflow))
                 / nullif(sum(inflow), 0), 1) AS "Savings rate"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

spec.description: The share of income you did not spend.
spec.title: Savings Rate

spec.rawSql:
SELECT round(sum(outflow)
             / nullif(count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', posted_on)), 0), 2)
           AS "Average month"
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

spec.description: Spending divided by the number of months that actually have data in range, so a part-month does not drag the figure down.
spec.title: Average Monthly Spending

spec.rawSql:
SELECT "time", net_worth AS "Net worth"
FROM v_net_worth_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Opening balances plus everything imported since, summed across accounts. Credit card balances count as negative.
spec.title: Net Worth

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('month', posted_on)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') AS "time",
       sum(inflow)  AS "Income",
       sum(outflow) AS "Spending",
       sum(inflow) - sum(outflow) AS "Net"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: All three series are dollars on one axis, so the gap between the bars is the line.
spec.title: Income vs spending by month

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $level AS metric, sum(outflow) AS value
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Slices always sum to total spending: anything tagged above the chosen depth shows as "(unspecified)" rather than vanishing, so nothing drops out of the chart.
spec.title: Financial Flow - $level

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('month', posted_on)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') AS "time",
       roll1 AS metric,
       sum(outflow) AS value
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Stacked, so the full height is the month's total.
spec.title: Categorical Monthly Spending
Overview
